name: web-basics
description: Small, original guidance pack used by MyGRACE tests and docs: native HTML semantics, accessible dialogs, cancellable requests.

guides.title: Prefer native semantic HTML
guides.description: Use native elements (button, dialog, details, label) before ARIA roles or JavaScript reimplementations.

guides.title: Accessible modal dialog
guides.description: Use the native dialog element with showModal(), a labelled heading and explicit close controls.

guides.title: Cancel stale fetch requests
guides.description: Abort superseded requests with AbortController instead of ignoring late responses.
